On behalf of our client, we are seeking a highly skilled full-time experienced ICT Business Analyst.   

As an ICT Business Analyst, you will be a key figure in the further development of our own proprietary system. The role involves carrying out assessments and analysis of current ICT business processes and making improvements to increase efficiency and reduce costs.

The daily duties and responsibilities include:
• Acts as a central reference and information source, providing guidance and assistance in the system project decision making process.
• Identifies, investigates, and analyses business processes, procedures and work practices. 
• Identifies and evaluates inefficiencies and recommends optimal business practices, and system functionality and behaviour
• Uses project management methodologies, principles and techniques to develop project plans and to cost, resource and manage projects
• Collaborate with teams across the business to deliver high quality service outcomes
• Uses data and process modelling techniques to create clear system specifications for the design and development of system software

Education – Bachelor degree or higher qualification desirable. Industry experience may substitute.

Experience & Skills 
• 2+ years’ work experience in a business system analyst role or similar
• Communication & technical skills
• Problem-solving & critical thinking skills
• Excellent time management
• Ability to work collaboratively and independently as required
• Confidence to communicate with multiple stakeholders and to manage expectations

Salary - Salary being offered is commensurate with qualifications and experience and is between $80,000 - $110,000
